verdict.rationale: Brave's docs show the API exposing (and exceeding) UI-level functionality—web/image/news/video/local search, Goggles re-ranking, summarizer, LLM Context endpoint, and official MCP integrations for agents (Claude, OpenClaw, Dify, n8n)—suggesting strong API/UI parity for AI-native use. However, community evidence indicates the free-tier ToS explicitly prohibits using API responses for 'AI inference,' contradicting the vendor's own AI-agent integration guides, and requires switching to a separate paid AI Inference plan to legally do what the docs promote.
